inputs.text: A 2D anime fighting game character idle animation, like a Street Fighter or Guilty Gear idle loop. The adult red-haired human pirate captain in a black tricorn hat, a long open black and gold pirate coat, an ivory blouse, a brown leather bodice, a short burgundy layered skirt and tall brown boots keeps the same right-facing planted stance. She holds ONE broad flared-muzzle blunderbuss scattergun horizontally at waist height in BOTH hands: her rear hand grips the wooden stock at the trigger, and her forward hand supports the wooden fore-end. Small silver mirror fragments remain inside the muzzle and in the two pouches at her hips. Like a confident fighting game gunner, she makes a steady measured rhythmic springy idle motion in place: her knees clearly bend and straighten, her hips and torso sink and rise together, and her shoulders and supported forearms rise and settle with her breathing. She keeps her back upright, chest lifted, chin level and eyes on the opponent. Her head and neck follow the torso naturally without nodding. Both hands keep exactly the same grips, and the scattergun moves together with her connected arms and shoulders as one heavy supported object. Repeat the same ready-guard breathing cycle several times; she is waiting, never aiming or attacking. Both feet stay flat on the ground in exactly the same spots; she never jumps and never steps. Her body keeps facing right and does not turn toward the camera. Her long red hair and long coat tails softly sway and settle after the body, while the skirt and hip pouches follow the same connected movement. The hat stays seated on her head. The scattergun barrel and stock stay straight and rigid, with constant shape, length and muzzle diameter. The silver fragments stay inside the gun and pouches. No firing, no recoil, no reload, no loose shards, no sparks, no smoke, no flames, no glow. Same face, same costume, same colors. Fixed camera, no zoom, full body always visible, flat plain green background.
